spec.scope: Rotation mechanic, not an attack buff — reduces the Burst Skill cooldown of every ally (including the B3 carry's, which is the binding constraint on FB cadence).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant permanent cooldown arithmetic per Full Burst entry — no buff duration at all. The ladder is CUMULATIVE ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'): entry 1 → 2.34s; entry 2 → 2.34+2.7 = 5.04s; entry 3 and EVERY entry after → 2.34+2.7+3.17 = 8.21s. The counter saturates at tier 3 but the trigger keeps firing on every subsequent FB.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter (ANY team Full Burst entry — 'Activates when entering Full Burst'), with an internal entry counter 1/2/3+. NOT burstCast.
spec.targetSet: All allies including self — every unit's burst CD, not just Liter's own B1.
spec.nearestWrongModel: (a) Non-cumulative tiers: applying only 3.17s from the 3rd entry instead of 8.21s; (b) counter treated as a 3-use cap so no CDR fires from the 4th FB onward; (c) target read as self-only, leaving the carry's B3 cooldown untouched (kills FB cadence); (d) keyed to burstCast, firing pre-FB.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp, on the 3rd and every later fullBurstStart, each ally's next burstCast frame moves earlier by 8.21s×60f relative to a withPatchedOverride('liter', strip-CDR-block) baseline — and the total fullBurstStart count over 180s is strictly higher with the block than without it, with the FB4→FB5 start gap matching an 8.21s (not 3.17s) reduction. Assert the CDR applies to the B3 carry's cooldown, not only Liter's.
spec.inertness: Emits NO stat buffApply events (pure cooldown arithmetic — no atkPct/critDamagePct/etc. from this block) and moves no damage bucket directly; all board movement must route through FB count/timing.

spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter — coincident with burstCast in the control fixture because Liter is the sole B1 and casts every rotation, so ONLY a timing assertion catches it (and it would over-fire in any comp where a FB happens without Liter casting). Secondary misread: dropped entirely as 'defensive/no damage'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'maxAmmoPct', value:45.17} lands at the SAME frame as Liter's burstCast event and STRICTLY BEFORE that rotation's fullBurstStart frame, targets all 5 units, expiresFrame = applyFrame + 300. Red if the apply frame equals fullBurstStart or the event is absent.
spec.inertness: After the 300-frame window ends the ammo cap must be back at base (Liter's own reloads refill to 120, not 174); no critDamagePct/atkPct buffApply may accompany the 1st cast.

Red under both the 10s and the FB-enter misreads.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of board impact: (1) The skill1 CDR ladder is the single largest rotation driver in any comp containing this unit — the trap is reading the tiers non-cumulatively (3.17s at 3+ instead of 8.21s) or capping the counter at three total procs; 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' means the saturated 8.21s fires on EVERY FB from the 3rd onward. Because FB counts on graded comps are measured-exact, the distinguishing test should be fullBurstStart timing/count against a CDR-stripped patched override, not just buff bookkeeping. Also verify the CDR reaches the B3 carry's cooldown — a self-only misread still produces SOME cadence change and can hide. (2) skill1 block B ('when using Burst Skill') is burstCast, but since this unit is the fixture's sole B1 it casts on every rotation, so burstCast and fullBurstEnter are count-coincident in controlComp — only a frame-level assertion (apply frame == burstCast frame, strictly < fullBurstStart) separates them. (3) The 45.17% max-ammo tier is a weapon-state line and must not be dropped as defensive. (4) Both 5s windows (skill1 tiers, burst 66%) invite inflation to the 10s FB duration; the burst window lapsing mid-FB is load-bearing for the carry's late-FB shots. (5) skill2's cover restore must not be encoded as a heal — in this exact fixture crown carries on-recovery consumers and a recovery-emitting encoding silently over-credits the team; it also has NO activation clause, so any modeled trigger would be invented (ALWAYS-⚑). Leak declaration: the redacted methodology is clean; the HARNESS API block does name this unit as controlComp's fixed B1 slot, but that is fixture wiring supplied by design (it carries no dispositions or magnitudes) — noted for completeness, and it means tests exercise the unit directly via withPatchedOverride on controlComp with any carry.
